title: Bar of two materials
description: A bar with a stiff and a soft half from a cell tag, pulled at its clamped end.

title: Material test: uniaxial tension
description: An eighth of a cube with symmetry planes, stretched to twice its length; the curve is the analytical one of the incompressible Neo-Hooke model.

title: Hexahedrons and tetrahedrons
description: A Gmsh file with hexahedrons and tetrahedrons, one mesh per type of cells, both nearly incompressible.

title: Rubber mount in shear
description: A rubber layer bonded between two steel plates, sheared by the top plate by its thickness.

title: Rubber block with a rigid plate
description: A rubber block on a fixed base, its top face glued to a rigid plate that is moved sideways and tilted at the same time.

title: Sandwich spring with parameters
description: Rubber discs between steel sheets, sheared by the top sheet. A Python script makes the mesh from the radius, the number and the height of the layers, the thickness of the sheets and the fineness.

title: Axisymmetric sandwich spring
description: The rubber discs between steel sheets as an axisymmetric model: the section in the xy-plane, x is the axis. The first sheet is pressed along the axis against the fixed last one; the force is the total over the circumference.

title: Plate with a hole in plane strain
description: A quarter of a rubber plate with a hole and two symmetry planes, pulled at its end; the stresses concentrate at the hole. A script makes the mesh from the radius of the hole, the width and the fineness.

title: Rubber-metal bushing (FElupe ex05)
description: A rubber bushing between two steel sleeves, the inner sleeve moved radially, twisted and tilted by a rigid connection. A script makes the mesh from the lengths of the sleeves, the runout and the fineness.
